status: source-proven dependency and finite API proposal only; no C/H mutation
finding: The real named interceptor has a query callback and no descriptor callback. V8 enumerable-key filtering invokes only the query, with no getter or value allocation.
The real own-property-descriptor path obtains attributes, then calls Object::GetProperty to obtain the actual data value. An existing key therefore has a distinct query-then-getter route.

The current QuickJS flags-only internal helper invokes exotic get_own_property with a temporary nonnull descriptor, then discards value/getter/setter. That callback input is the same as a full own descriptor request.

A single existing callback therefore cannot preserve both actual EnvQuery-only enumeration and EnvQuery-plus-EnvGetter full descriptors without an explicit VM operation distinction. A value read adds actual Map/string copies, intrinsic string allocation and Trace get.

proposal.abi: Optional get_own_property_flags(ctx, int* flags, borrowed obj, atom) field appended to JSClassExoticMethods. Return -1/0/1 under the existing attribute/existence contract.
proposal.selection: Only the existing flags_only branch may select the optional hook. If absent, the entire previous temporary-descriptor fallback remains unchanged. Ordinary objects, full descriptors, value Gets, null-descriptor existence checks and Proxy behavior retain their existing paths.
proposal.native_env_consumer: EnvQuery-only for the new flags hook. Full descriptor remains actual EnvQuery then EnvGetter; ordinary get_property remains actual getter plus original not-intercepted prototype continuation.
controls: Distinct callback counters and returned value holder prove flags-only invokes no getter or retirement.
Existing classes without the optional hook retain the old fallback and descriptor ownership.
Actual pending ordinary/private/fatal outcomes and prior-pending admission must follow the current VM boundary contract.
Future process.env controls must distinguish enumerate/query/get trace order, missing keys and full descriptors.

limits: This is not a process.env implementation, VM patch, runtime observation or complete native template review.
All mutable Main files are read-only. The selected linked source regions are pinned to the full file hashes above.
Other process.env interceptors, cached constructor/prototype semantics and preventExtensions behavior remain separate source work.
